dimensions.label: Task Fit & Completeness
dimensions.description: Does it fully address the brief? Are all requested elements present?

dimensions.label: Strategic Judgment
dimensions.description: Is prioritization/tradeoff reasoning sound? Does it show real product/business judgment, not generic advice?

dimensions.label: Clarity & Structure
dimensions.description: Is it well organized, scannable, and free of padding or filler?

dimensions.label: Actionability
dimensions.description: Are next steps, owners, and decision points concrete enough to act on?

dimensions.label: Voice & Audience Fit
dimensions.description: Is the tone/register right for the stated audience (exec, eng, customer, etc.)?

dimensions.label: Rigor & Accuracy
dimensions.description: No hallucinated facts/numbers; internal consistency; sound assumptions clearly flagged as assumptions.
